title: Onboard Maintenance — Maintenance Terminal Report Correlation Installation
abstract: Installation of the correlating maintenance terminal interface unit and its application load, collapsing cascaded built-in test reports into a single ranked cause for the line engineer.

sections.planning_reason: A single failure on a shared bus can produce forty or more correlated reports, and a line engineer working to a turnaround clock replaces the first item on the list. Across a two-year fleet sample, thirty-eight per cent of avionics removals returned no fault found, and in two thirds of those cases a later report in the same list named the item that was actually faulty. The whole cost falls on the operator, in shop charges and in spares turnover, and nothing about it is visible to the aircraft.
sections.description: The terminal interface unit is replaced by an item hosting the correlation engine, and the data concentrator is re-strapped to feed it the raw report stream rather than the pre-filtered one. The correlation application is loaded through the existing portable loader. The terminal then presents a ranked list of candidate causes with the supporting reports collapsed underneath, and keeps the unfiltered list one key press away.
sections.accomplishment_summary: Put the aircraft on ground power. Open the forward equipment area and do AMM-S-45-20-12-700-044-A to record the pre-modification terminal configuration. Remove the terminal interface unit and install the item D4520127216664 from the kit. Re-strap the data concentrator D4520123766196 in accordance with the strapping table. Renew the loop clamp LN563558-5B and the grommet AES4363-5C at the harness entry, because the connector shell changes. Load the correlation application LE9L7F7E375 onto the receiver 2TM using the portable data loader and confirm the load by the checksum given in the accomplishment instructions. Do AMM-S-45-20-12-700-044-A again to verify the correlation function against the built-in test injection sequence. Confirm that the unfiltered report list is still reachable. Record the embodiment.
sections.effectivity_note: Applicable to all SOLANO and VANTOR aircraft in the programme. Aircraft from MSN S01521 onward are post-modification from build. There is no pre-modification condition: the change is self-contained and does not depend on any other standard.
sections.material_note: Kit K4520-1002-01 contains the interface unit, the clamp and grommet set and the application media. Lead time is eleven weeks. The removed interface unit is returned to Aeralis and the operator receives an exchange credit.
